ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, Vendor shall (a) provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because Section 10 has no obligation on Vendor to return our data or help us migrate. Our position is up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
